purpose: Exact captured preimage versus isolated prompt-7 transport patch regression evidence
isolated_build_procedure: Root strictly compiled captured broadcast-before.c and broadcast-after.c, where after contains only the prompt-7 scoped transport patch transplanted into the same captured preimage.

For each mode, a private copy of build/libradios_ui.a was made. The matching root object was copied into mode/broadcast.c.o and ar r replaced the broadcast.c.o archive member. The original shared archive was not modified.
Current test_live_players_ui.c was compiled with strict C11, -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror, and linked to the private UI archive plus existing playout/audio/core archives.

Linker --wrap symbols: radios_media_library_get, radios_media_library_open_for_deck, radios_player_loader_open, radios_audio_ui_get_snapshot, radios_audio_ui_load_media, radios_audio_ui_play, radios_audio_ui_pause, radios_audio_ui_stop.

after.observed_stdout_result: TAP 1..11, all 11 cases reported ok; the entire suite completed with exit code 0.

limitations: This is an isolated proof of the prompt-7 transport patch against an exact captured preimage, not a claim that the shared current source tree built successfully.
Concurrent unrelated queue progress/preview API integration changes were still in progress and prevented the full current-source build at the time of this isolated validation.

Only the broadcast translation unit preimage/after pair is exact source material in this proof. Other translation units are existing build archives and are not claimed to match exact current source revisions.
The tests exercise actual Broadcast GTK callbacks with controlled library/audio boundary wrappers. They do not claim PCM decoder, backend, hardware or whole-application acceptance.
artifact_preservation_note: The original unversioned after executable path was temporarily reused for suite v12. The exact v11 test source was reconstructed and matched the recorded SHA. Compiling it with __FILE__ prefix mapping produced a byte-identical v11 after executable with the original recorded SHA; immutable_v11_artifacts now names preserved versions. No shared source or original archive was rolled back.
